_comment: What the macOS package's build downloads, pinned (D742): the file is refused if its SHA-256 differs, and the refusal prints the SHA-256 it found. CI checks each pin against the publisher's own list first (`checksums`; build.py check-pins). To update: change the version, url and checksums, let CI download it once, and put the SHA-256 it prints here; CI then checks it against the publisher's list. bomutils publishes no list (its file is GitHub's archive of the tag): its pin is the first download's (2026-11-26).
